title: 법원조사관 등 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:1:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2-1 (Legal Investigation Officers)
(1) Legal investigation officers may be assigned to the Supreme Court.
(2) Legal investigation officers shall be appointed as specialized fixed-term public officials.
(3) Under the direction of a judicial research officer who is a judge, legal investigation officers shall collect and investigate materials necessary for adjudicating civil, criminal, and administrative cases, and perform other necessary duties.
